search_input_transfer_info_button:
To transfer domains, follow this easy format:

  • For domains with EPP Codes: domain1.com eppcode
  • For domains without EPP Codes: domain2.com

You can transfer up to 10 domains in bulk. Simply place each domain on a new line. If you have an EPP Code, add it after the domain.
